title: Gamma-ray Bursts as Cosmological Probes Calibrated with Strongly Lensed Quasars and Neural Networks
summary: Gamma-ray bursts (GRBs) extend distance measurements to redshifts beyond those routinely probed by Type Ia supernovae, but their use in cosmology is limited by calibration circularity and possible redshift-dependent effects. We investigate strongly lensed quasars as external calibrators of the Amati and Combo GRB relations. We reconstruct the luminosity-distance relation using an artificial neural network trained on TDCOSMO strong-lensing distances, with the absolute scale inherited from the lensing-only calibration. To avoid extrapolation, only GRBs within the lens-supported redshift interval are used for calibration. We then infer cosmological parameters through a hierarchical Bayesian analysis of flat $Λ$CDM, with $w_0w_a$CDM examined as a consistency test. For flat $Λ$CDM, Amati yields $H_0=78.26^{+17.87}_{-16.30}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.670^{+0.223}_{-0.276}$, while Combo yields $H_0=78.71^{+13.83}_{-11.29}\,\mathrm{km\,s^{-1}\,Mpc^{-1}}$ and $Ω_m=0.635^{+0.235}_{-0.242}$. Amati is relatively insensitive to the phenomenological redshift term, whereas Combo shows a stronger dependence. Injection--recovery tests indicate that an unmodelled positive Combo trend can bias $H_0$ and $Ω_m$ upward. Strong-lens calibration therefore offers a route to extending the GRB Hubble diagram, but the inferred $H_0$ is not an independent GRB measurement: it retains the TDCOSMO distance scale. The precision is limited by GRB scatter, redshift-dependent systematics, and lens-modelling uncertainties.

title: Late-time distance consistency and model-independent curvature inference with strong lensing, quasars, and galaxy clusters
comment: 18 pages, 6 figures, Accepted for publication in Research in Astronomy and Astrophysics (RAA)
summary: We revisit a late-time, model-independent distance-consistency framework that combines strong gravitational lensing systems (SGLS), ultraviolet/X-ray quasars (QSOs), and 38 Sunyaev--Zel'dovich/X-ray galaxy-cluster angular-diameter distances. The analysis focuses on systematics rather than on presenting a competitive curvature measurement. Starting from the 158-system SGLS catalog, we exclude 30 systems that violate the lensing-geometric requirement $D_{A,ls}/D_{A,s}<1$ in the isothermal reference case $γ_{\rm lens}=2$, leaving a fixed 128-system SGLS parent sample for cross-matching with 1598 QSOs. A deterministic maximum-cardinality, minimum-mismatch one-to-one assignment yields 100 SGLS--QSO pairs at the nominal $Δd/d=5\%$ threshold. We propagate the measured X-ray flux uncertainties and the intrinsic QSO scatter, and, crucially, we include the full $38\times38$ covariance induced by using the same QSO distances in the kernel-smoothed cluster predictions. With $Ω_K\sim\mathcal{U}[-10,10]$, the joint posterior is $Ω_K=2.085^{+1.634}_{-1.103}$ (68\%; central 95\% interval $[0.269,6.028]$). We do not interpret the positive shift as evidence for an open Universe. \added{This positive posterior offset is driven by cross-probe calibration tensions, sample-assignment effects, and the cluster anchor; it cannot be attributed to the intrinsic spatial geometry of the Universe.} The SGLS+QSO data alone leave curvature essentially prior dominated, $Ω_K=0.70^{+6.33}_{-7.12}$, whereas removing only the off-diagonal cluster covariance moves the posterior to $Ω_K=5.21^{+2.46}_{-2.07}$. Thus the cluster anchor supplies most of the curvature constraining power and its covariance materially changes the posterior location.

AI.tldr: 论文重新审视一个结合强引力透镜系统(SGLS)、紫外/X射线类星体(QSOs)与38个SZ/X射线星系团角径距离的晚期、模型无关距离一致性框架，重点研究系统误差而非给出竞争性的曲率测量。
AI.motivation: 作者希望在一个晚期、模型无关的距离一致性框架中刻画曲率限制的来源与稳健性，特别关注跨探针系统误差、样本匹配效应以及共用QSO距离引入的相关性如何影响结果，而非把联合后验当作宇宙空间几何的证据。
AI.method: 从158个系统的SGLS目录出发，剔除在等温参考情况γ_lens=2下违反D_{A,ls}/D_{A,s}<1的30个系统，保留128个固定SGLS母样本，并与1598个QSO进行确定性最大基数、最小失配的一对一匹配，在Δd/d=5%阈值下得到100个SGLS–QSO对。分析中传播X射线流量不确定度与QSO内禀散布，并引入使用同一批QSO距离进行核平滑星系团预测所产生的完整38×38协方差；先验取Ω_K~U[-10,10]。
AI.result: 联合后验为Ω_K=2.085^{+1.634}_{-1.103}（68%；95%中心区间[0.269,6.028]）。作者明确指出这一正向偏移由跨探针定标张力、样本指派效应和星系团锚点驱动，不能归因于宇宙内禀空间几何。仅用SGLS+QSO时曲率基本由先验主导，Ω_K=0.70^{+6.33}_{-7.12}；而仅移除星系团协方差的非对角项后，后验移动到Ω_K=5.21^{+2.46}_{-2.07}。

title: Statistical Strong Lensing V. Inference with Microlensed Quasars
comment: 12 pages, 5 figures. Submitted to Astronomy & Astrophysics
summary: Microlensing of strongly lensed quasars provides direct information on the stellar component of lens galaxies, and can help break the degeneracy between the stellar initial mass function (IMF) and the dark matter. However, a statistical framework to forward model microlensing data while accounting for strong lensing selection effects is still missing. We incorporated microlensing effects into the hierarchical model of Paper III, and investigated to what extent flux measurements of strongly lensed quasars can break the degeneracy between the stellar IMF and the dark matter distribution. We tested the method on a mock sample of 219 doubly imaged quasars, lensed by circularly symmetric lenses. When microlensing effects are modelled, the inference using image fluxes recovers the input foreground population parameters and provides tighter constraints than the inference without flux constraints. The improvement is clearest in the $μ_α-μ_5$ plane, where $μ_α$ describes the mean stellar population synthesis mismatch parameter $\logα_{\rm SPS}$ and $μ_5$ describes the mean projected dark matter mass within $5\,{\rm kpc}$. The 68% credible interval on $μ_α$ shrinks from 0.16 dex to 0.09 dex, with the degeneracy between $μ_α$ and $μ_5$ significantly reduced. By contrast, fitting the image fluxes without accounting for microlensing leads to large biases on the inferred parameters. title: Mock Catalogs of Strongly Lensed Gravitational Waves via a Halo Model Approach with Space-borne Detectors
comment: 20 pages, 13 figures, 11 tables, to appear in ApJS
summary: Future space-borne gravitational-wave (GW) detectors, such as LISA and DECIGO, are expected to detect a large number of GW events, a fraction of which may be strongly lensed by intervening galaxies or galaxy clusters. In this work, we develop a comprehensive framework to simulate strongly lensed GWs in the context of space-borne detectors. Based on realistic astrophysical models for both the source population and the lens distribution, we construct mock catalogs of lensed GW events, referred to as \textbf{GW-LMC-Space}. Our results show that, for a four-year LISA observation, the expected number of lensed events ranges from $0$ to $131$, depending on the adopted formation model of massive black hole binaries (MBHBs). The corresponding lensing probability for MBHBs can reach up to $\sim 0.3\%$. For DECIGO, we find that the number of lensed events in a one-year observation is expected to lie in the range of $0$--$44$, with a lensing probability of $\sim 0.15\%$ for stellar-mass binary black holes (BBHs), binary neutron stars (BNSs), and neutron star--black hole binaries (NSBHs). We further show that the overlap of lensed signals is a common feature in space-borne detectors, which can significantly affect both the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) estimation and event identification. These results highlight the importance of accounting for signal overlap in the analysis of strongly lensed GW events in future space-borne GW observations.

title: ALMA2040: The High-Redshift Circumgalactic Medium. Imaging the fueling and feedback of galaxies in the early universe
comment: Part of the ALMA2040 White Paper Series. 11 pages, 2 figures
summary: Galaxies do not form in isolation, but rather as part of a wider interconnected web mediated at their interface by an extended gaseous atmosphere - the Circum-Galactic Medium (CGM). This dynamic and multiphase region is fed and shaped by gas inflows and mergers from the intergalactic medium and by feedback-driven outflows and radiation from the central galaxy. The CGM is imprinted by the past, present and future evolution of its central galaxy and environment. The cool atomic and molecular phases are of particular interest as they dominate the mass budget of outflows and provide a reservoir of direct star forming fuel for the galaxy to accrete. In the early universe where accretion rates, mergers, and feedback processes peak, the cycle of gas through the CGM is most vigorous. Sub-mm observations have detected cold gas in extended halos and gas flows around high redshift galaxies but are thus far limited to the most massive, extreme or gravitationally lensed sources, using just a handful of the strongest emission and absorption lines. A significant increase ($5-10\times$) in spectral line sensitivity compared with the current ALMA is needed to push physical scales, densities and properties to a new regime. We present three key scientific cases for an ALMA2040 telescope: (i) direct imaging of extended [CII]-traced CGM halos around Milky-Way-progenitor galaxies at $z=4$-8; (ii) resolved detection of cold, clumpy outflows on $\sim$100 pc scales tied to individual star-forming clumps; and (iii) multi-species/-transition emission and absorption diagnostics that jointly constrain the density, chemistry, and radiation fields permeating the cool CGM and its multiphase gas flows.

title: Can Blue UV-Bright Galaxies Drive Reionization at Cosmic Dawn? An $M_{\rm UV}=-19.6$ Galaxy with $f_{\rm esc}\approx0.85$ at $z=9.244$
comment: 15 pages, 6 figures, 2 tables. Submitted to ApJL. Comments welcome!
summary: We revisit EBG-1, a gravitationally lensed galaxy at $z = 9.244$, using newly obtained deep (14 hr) JWST/NIRSpec G235M ($R \sim 1000$) spectroscopy. EBG-1 is one of the bluest galaxies observed at $z > 9$. Along with its remarkably blue continuum of $β= -2.99 \pm 0.15$, we find very weak nebular emission from EBG-1. We obtain a $3σ$ upper limit of EW $< 8.4$ Angstrom for C III], a marginal H$β$ measurement (EW $= 256.2 \pm 122.2$ Angstrom), and a $5σ$ detection of [O III] $λ5007$ (EW $= 882.8 \pm 180.6$ Angstrom). These lines suggest an oxygen abundance of $12 + \log(\mathrm{O/H}) = 7.16 \pm 0.25$ ($\simeq 3\% Z_{\odot}$) and $\log(\mathrm{C/O}) < -0.88$ ($3σ$), placing EBG-1 on the C/O-metallicity sequence traced by lower-redshift galaxies. To constrain the escape fraction ($f_{\rm esc}$), we compare the observed UV slope and emission-line equivalent widths with synthetic spectra generated using BEAGLE. The models favor $f_{\rm esc} \gtrsim 0.75$, with $f_{\rm esc} \approx 0.85$ providing the best overall agreement with the observations. These results suggest that relatively UV-bright galaxies like EBG-1 can achieve the exceptionally high ionizing efficiencies supported by late reionization scenarios.

title: Probing cold gas and dust in quiescent galaxies across cosmic time
summary: The discovery of massive quiescent galaxies at high redshift by JWST has revealed that star formation can cease rapidly in the early Universe, yet the physical mechanisms responsible for quenching remain unknown. A key missing element is the systematic measurement in statistically representative quiescent samples of the cold gas and dust content, which are crucial for distinguishing quenching mechanisms and evolutionary pathways. Such observations are currently not feasible because state-of-the-art sub-millimeter facilities (e.g., ALMA) cannot routinely detect the faint molecular gas and dust reservoirs of quiescent galaxies, nor pinpoint outflowing molecular gas. A next-generation facility (ALMA2040) capable of providing transformative access to the cold interstellar medium of quiescent galaxies across redshift is therefore essential. In particular, it will allow the community to probe the molecular gas content of quiescent galaxies at cosmic noon and beyond by targeting the CO, [CI], and [CII] emission lines, as well as unveiling the physical conditions of the cold interstellar medium by constraining the CO spectral line energy distribution. It will also reveal the dust content of the passive population, a crucial ingredient to constrain the different quenching mechanisms. Finally, it will enable probing the molecular gas kinematics and identify molecular outflows driven by supermassive black holes. When combined with the rich legacy of JWST, ELT, and SKAO surveys, ALMA2040 will deliver a comprehensive, multi-phase view of feedback and quenching, allowing us to establish when, how, and why galaxies shut down their star formation across cosmic time.

title: Kinematically isolating intracluster light in AS1063: a distinct stellar population tracing the dark matter core
summary: We present a technique using integral-field spectroscopy to kinematically isolate intracluster light (ICL) from the brightest cluster galaxy (BCG), enabling insights into their contrasting stellar populations and the inner dark matter halo profile. Applying this technique to MUSE data of Abell S1063, we find that both components are old (~9 Gyr), but the ICL is more metal-poor than the BCG, implying distinct progenitor pathways. Within 100 kpc, the ICL comprises 55 per cent of the BCG+ICL stellar mass - substantially more than inferred from photometric decompositions. The BCG and ICL possess distinct velocity distributions, which remain nearly constant with radius, with an ICL velocity dispersion more than twice that of the BCG, and a line-of-sight velocity offset of 86 +- 18 km/s. Two-dimensional Sérsic fits yield an ICL centroid offset of 5.2 +- 1.5 kpc from the BCG. These phase-space offsets are indicative of the BCG oscillating in a broad potential minimum. Furthermore, the ICL surface-brightness profile matches that of strong-lensing estimates assuming a cored halo. Simulations indicate that the inner halo profile varies systematically for different dark matter models. Applied to larger samples, our method therefore offers a complementary route to testing the nature of dark matter, while simultaneously revealing the stellar origins of the ICL.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 我们提出一种利用积分场光谱技术从最亮星系团星系（BCG）中运动学分离星系团内光（ICL）的方法，从而能够洞察两者截然不同的星族以及内部暗物质晕轮廓。将该技术应用于Abell S1063的MUSE数据，我们发现两个组分均较年老（约9 Gyr），但ICL的金属丰度低于BCG，暗示其前身途径不同。在100 kpc范围内，ICL占BCG+ICL恒星质量的55%——远高于测光分解所推断的比例。BCG和ICL具有不同的速度分布，且该分布随半径几乎保持不变，ICL的速度弥散超过BCG的两倍，视向速度偏移为86 ± 18 km/s。二维Sérsic拟合得到ICL质心相对于BCG的偏移为5.2 ± 1.5 kpc。这些相空间偏移表明BCG在宽阔的势阱中振荡。此外，ICL的表面亮度轮廓与假设核心晕的强引力透镜估计相符。模拟表明，内部晕轮廓在不同暗物质模型下系统性变化。因此，应用于更大样本时，我们的方法为检验暗物质本质提供了互补途径，同时揭示了ICL的恒星起源。

title: Dual and lensed AGN at sub-arcsecond separations uncovered by ERIS
comment: 22 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Accepted for publication in Astronomy & Astrophysics
summary: We present the first results of the ongoing INAF GTO program focused on the search of sub-arcsecond dual AGN, carried out with the near-infrared integral-field unit SPIFFIER of the Enhanced Resolution Imager and Spectrograph (ERIS) at the ESO Very Large Telescope, operating in adaptive-optics mode with a laser guide star. We report integral field spectroscopy with the low-resolution gratings (R ~ 5000 - 5600) of 34 multiple AGN candidates selected from the Gaia Data Release 3 source catalog via the Gaia Multi-Peak (GMP) method, which preferentially identifies luminous unobscured AGN at sub-arcsecond separations. The targets span the redshift range 0.7 < z < 3.4 and exhibit projected angular separations between ~0.2'' and ~0.9'', corresponding to physical separations of ~1.7-7.8 kpc. Of the 34 observed systems,13 (~40 %) are resolved into multiple AGN-like components; 18 (~53 %) are classified as AGN plus foreground star superpositions, one as a single AGN, and two as systems with an AGN primary and an unclassified secondary component. Among the multiple AGN systems, we confirm six dual AGN at projected separations of 0.26'' - 0.80'' (2.2 - 6.7 kpc), in the redshift range z = 0.68 - 1.57, and with velocity offsets in the range Δv ~ 290 - 950 km/s. We also identify seven gravitationally lensed quasars, only one of which was previously known, including four doubly imaged and three quadruply imaged systems. These results substantially enlarge the census of spectroscopically confirmed compact multiple AGN systems at z > 0.5 and demonstrate the efficiency of ERIS-SPIFFIER for the systematic characterization of sub-arcsecond dual and lensed AGN candidates.

title: Environmental dependence in the halo model informed by the FLAMINGO simulations
comment: 16 pages. Prepared for submission to A&A
summary: Galaxy-galaxy lensing (GGL) measurements around galaxy samples in different environments provide valuable information about the galaxy-halo connection. In such studies the halo model is commonly used to estimate physical parameters from the lensing signal, but the impact of environment is generally not considered. Our aim is to adapt the halo model to allow a density-split GGL analysis and to understand the environmental dependence of the elements of the model. We use the FLAMINGO suite of cosmological hydrodynamical simulations to construct samples of halos in underdense and overdense regions. Environment density is assigned to halos based on halo counts within an aperture, employing different aperture sizes to probe both local and large scales. We utilize spherical apertures with radii between $1 h^{-1} {\rm Mpc}$ and $10 h^{-1} {\rm Mpc}$. We find a strong dependence on environment for the halo mass function (HMF) and the halo bias. To account for this, we propose an empirical modification that can be applied to existing HMF prescriptions. We find that after a density split, the halo bias is approximately constant with mass. There is also an environmental dependence for the stellar-to-halo-mass relation (SHMR), the conditional stellar mass function, and the mass-concentration relation, all of which can be addressed with existing models. We evaluate the impact of overlooking environment on halo occupation distribution (HOD) parameter inference, finding that it leads to biased estimations of the SHMR and the satellite fraction. These results emphasize the need to review the assumptions adopted in the halo model when working with samples of galaxies binned by environment, and consequently, by galaxy properties that correlate with environment, such as morphology and color.

artifacts.abstract_zh: 在不同环境下星系样本周围的星系-星系透镜（GGL）测量为星系-晕连接提供了宝贵信息。在此类研究中，晕模型通常用于从透镜信号估计物理参数，但环境的影响一般未被考虑。我们的目标是调整晕模型以允许密度分割的GGL分析，并理解模型元素的环境依赖性。我们使用FLAMINGO宇宙学流体动力学模拟套件来构建欠密和过密区域中的晕样本。环境密度基于孔径内的晕计数分配给晕，采用不同的孔径大小来探测局部和大尺度。我们使用半径在$1 h^{-1} {\rm Mpc}$到$10 h^{-1} {\rm Mpc}$之间的球形孔径。我们发现晕质量函数（HMF）和晕偏置对环境有强烈依赖。为了解释这一点，我们提出了一种可以应用于现有HMF规定的经验修正。我们发现，在密度分割后，晕偏置随质量大致恒定。恒星-晕质量关系（SHMR）、条件恒星质量函数和质量-浓度关系也存在环境依赖性，所有这些都可以用现有模型来处理。我们评估了忽略环境对晕占据分布（HOD）参数推断的影响，发现它会导致SHMR和卫星分数的有偏估计。这些结果强调，当处理按环境分箱的星系样本时，需要重新审视晕模型中采用的假设，并因此按与环境相关的星系属性（如形态和颜色）分箱时也是如此。
artifacts.conclusion_zh: 基于现有摘要：对按环境（以及与环境相关的形态、颜色等星系属性）分箱的样本开展晕模型分析时，需重新审视模型的基本假设，并纳入环境依赖的修正。

figures.caption_zh: 图6：与图3相同，但显示了在FLAMINGO模拟中获得的最过密（实线）和最欠密（虚线）晕样本的SHMR与相应模拟盒或光锥的总SHMR的比率。误差棒表示均值的标准误差。

figures.caption_en: Figure 7: Stellar-to-halo-mass relation at \(z=0\) , fit with Eq. 13 using different parameters \([\gamma_{2},\ M_{0},\ M_{1}]\) and a shared parameter \(\gamma_{1}\) for the three bins. Error bars correspond to the standard error on the mean.
figures.caption_zh: 图7：\(z=0\)时的恒星-晕质量关系，使用公式13拟合，三个分箱使用不同的参数\([\gamma_{2},\ M_{0},\ M_{1}]\)和共享参数\(\gamma_{1}\)。误差棒对应均值的标准误差。

figures.caption_en: Figure 8: Conditional stellar mass function for central (top panels) and satellite galaxies (bottom panels) for three different density samples. The markers show the measurement in the FLAMINGO box, while the solid lines show the best fit to Eqs. 23 and 14 for \(M_{*}>10^{10}h^{-2}M_{\odot}\) and \(M_{h}>10^{11.5}h^{-1}M_{\odot}\) . The parameters \(\sigma_{c}\) and \(s\) are shared between the three density bins. The range of halo masses corresponding to each plot is shown in brackets as \(\log(M_{h}hM_{\odot}^{-1})\) . Error bars were obtained by jackknife resampling with 27 regions.
figures.caption_zh: 图8：三个不同密度样本的中心星系（上图）和卫星星系（下图）的条件恒星质量函数。标记显示FLAMINGO模拟盒中的测量，实线显示对公式23和14在\(M_{*}>10^{10}h^{-2}M_{\odot}\)和\(M_{h}>10^{11.5}h^{-1}M_{\odot}\)范围内的最佳拟合。参数\(\sigma_{c}\)和\(s\)在三个密度分箱之间共享。每个图对应的晕质量范围以\(\log(M_{h}hM_{\odot}^{-1})\)显示在括号中。误差棒通过27个区域的刀切重采样获得。
